project_context.archetype: 3 (Pastel & Soft) elevated to Premium SaaS Luxury
project_context.target_audience: Modern enterprises, restaurants, retail, travel agencies, and service businesses.
project_context.core_aesthetic: Glassmorphism 2.0 (tactile depth, diffused blur), clarity-led minimalism, soft white base with vibrant lavender/purple gradients, floating rounded cards.
anti_patterns: No flat, sterile white layouts without texture or gradient blooms.
No AI human avatars (use abstract orbs/geometry).
No generic 3-column bootstrap layouts. Use asymmetric bento grids.

tracing_beam_card.description: Used for the AI Assistant and Automation showcase to signal 'Active/Alive' tech.
tracing_beam_card.implementation: Use Framer Motion to animate a glowing border around the glass_card.

hero.left: Massive H1 (Cabinet Grotesk), Warm Amber primary CTA, sub-text.
hero.right: Floating glass command center mockup layered over an abstract pulsating purple geometric 3D orb. NO human face.
hero.background: White base with a slow-moving, heavy blurred, radial background blob of #7C5CFF (opacity 20%).

marquee.implementation: Slow drifting horizontal ribbon showcasing 12 languages (flags + names) and client types. Extremely generous spacing.

modules_bento.items: CRM (span 8), Web Studio (span 4), POS Restaurant (span 6), POS Retail (span 6), Travel (span 4), Inventory (span 8). Use varied heights and inner padding.

footer.cta: Huge 'LEVOND' text at 10vw for a premium tech feel.

hero_abstract.description: Abstract purple geometric 3D knot for AI representation

modules.description: Diverse professional team in modern office

instructions_to_main_agent: Create the landing page using plain React components (.js/.jsx) with Tailwind CSS. DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, language switchers, links) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='hero-cta-button'`).
Do NOT use HTML `<select>` or native `date`. Use custom UI implementations or well-styled Tailwind alternatives that mimic Shadcn behavior.
Implement Framer Motion for scroll reveals, floating cards, and the abstract AI orb animation.
Do not include any human face or Avatar for the AI assistant. Use the provided abstract 3D orb image.
Ensure the hero header is sticky with `backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70`, contains the 12-language switcher, and prominent 'Probar gratis' CTA.
Use Lucide-React for all iconography. Emojis are forbidden.
Strictly follow the color palette. Do not invent new gradients. Use the defined Primary (#7C5CFF) and Accent (#FFB042) intentionally.
